features.title: Plugin updates waiting for a Host restart
features.summary: A Plugins-page row names every plugin whose browser half rebuilt while its Host half still runs from before the rebuild, so the page keeps the last-good client code instead of running new client code against old Host code.
failureModes: A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half did not change applies immediately, as before.
A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half changed is announced as deferred; the browser keeps the last-good code and the row names the package until a Host restart.
A Host that reloads the package in-process releases the deferral and announces the rebuild.
A bundle directory removed by a clean build, or one that cannot be watched, is polled until a watch reopens; a 10 s re-read covers dropped watch events.

verification.testName: defers while the Host half on disk is not the loaded one
releases a deferral when the Host reloaded that artifact
reads an owned bundle entry from exports
reads only the rewritten bundle after a directory event, without polling idle bundles
falls back to polling a removed bundle directory and resumes when a clean build recreates it

verification.reason: A deferral needs a plugin whose Host half is rebuilt on disk while the Host keeps the old one loaded; no Gherkin scenario sets that up yet. The feature's reach steps open the empty row on a scratch DSH with dshx dev open, and the defer and release decisions are unit-tested in src/host/gate.test.ts.

features.title: Plugin updates waiting for a restart in the Inbox
features.summary: While any rebuilt plugin is held back because its new Host code is not loaded, the Inbox shows one Ready item about this DSH naming the waiting packages and how to apply them (restart when no agent is working). It offers no restart verb: restarting stays the user's decision. A changed set of packages shows again after Done; the item resolves once nothing waits.
failureModes: Without the inbox (activity-timeline) loaded, the gate works exactly as before; the provider reconciles when the inbox announces it is ready.
The item never restarts or reloads anything; it only says what waits and how to apply it.

externalDependencies.boundary: attention-api module: reconcile through the dshx Host API client.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/host/attention.test.ts serves the attention contract from a fake inbox Host on a real Cordis test Host.

verification.testName: states held-back rebuilds as one Ready item with recovery text and no restart verb
states the deferred set to the inbox after a burst, again when the inbox is ready, and nothing once it applied

verification.reason: A deferred update needs a plugin's Host bundle rebuilt under a running scratch DSH while its client is served; the provider round trip is proven on a real Cordis Host in src/host/attention.test.ts.

features.title: Held-back bundles join the one restart notice
features.summary: While a rebuilt plugin waits for a Host restart, hmr-gate lists it in thread-sidebar's restart sources, so the status strip's one Restart pending item names it beside the Host files thread-sidebar watches. thread-sidebar owns that item and its Restart DSH / Restart when idle verbs; restarting stays the user's confirmed decision, and the Plugins page row explains what would apply.
failureModes: Without thread-sidebar or frame-layout no strip item shows; the Plugins page row and the Inbox item still report the pending restart.

verification.reason: Needs a deferred Host rebuild frame; walked with the pending-restart seed in a scratch DSH rather than a Gherkin scenario.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: it reads the deferred packages the hmr-gate event stream already delivered.
